well_truly_crunchies.diagnosis: Despite shopper interest, no one purchased well_truly_crunchies, suggesting a barrier to purchase.
well_truly_crunchies.action: Test a price promotion or highlight key benefits/ingredients on the front of the pack.

top_shelf.diagnosis: Despite significant shopper interest, no one purchased the top_shelf product, suggesting a barrier to conversion.
top_shelf.action: Test a price promotion or clearer pack information on the back of the product.

crisps_packs.diagnosis: A small but engaged shopper group is converting well, but some are hesitant, suggesting a potential barrier to purchase.
crisps_packs.action: Test a price promotion or clearer ingredient/nutritional information on the back of the crisps packs.

kooky_snacks.diagnosis: Only brief glances - the product isn't drawing real attention.
kooky_snacks.action: Improve visibility: move to eye level or add a shelf talker.
